svg.text: Figure 4. Simulated paediatric concentration-time profiles (virtual population, N=400)
Left: single 10 mg dose (0-48 h), median, with reported geomean Cmax/tmax marker (Tirucherai). Right: 10 mg once daily at
steady state, median + 90% prediction interval (the app's main output).
VERDICT: PASS - simulated tmax (1.3 h) and profile shape consistent with reported paediatric data; steady-state accumulation as expected
reported geomean Cmax 118 ng/mL at tmax 0.88 h
B. 10 mg QD, steady state (median + 90% PI)
